# The History of Baptismal Practice Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L18 - The History of Baptismal Practice.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L18 - The History of Baptismal Practice
- Big idea: Historical evidence can trace changing baptismal practice but cannot replace exegesis of the canonical texts.
- Primary reading: Acts 2:38-41; Romans 6:1-11; selected historical sources

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
